messages:
lina (sales): Heads-up — NorthStar Bank wants BYOK via Thales Luna (on-prem) with an offline key ceremony and 3-person custody for KEKs. They also want a signed rotation attestation after each rotation and 12-month archival of rotation logs. Can we scope a POC + ops-handoff? @rahul @cate

 rahul (solutions): Summary of POC goals: validate manual key import (offline ceremony), automated binding to model endpoints, rotate KEK twice (simulate emergency and scheduled), test failover to DR region, and verify audit log export + archival. Propose 3-week POC so we can do ceremony + full rotation cycle.

 cate (security): Security notes: 3-person custody OK, need to confirm vendor attestation options for Hardware-backed key provenance. We'll need to fill their SIG about key escrow policies (we don't escrow customer KEKs). For the attestation, we can produce a signed export of rotation events plus an executed PS attestation letter. Archival per their request (12mo) is fine but extra retention is billable.

 lina (sales): They also asked if Redwood can host the rotation orchestration or if they must run it in their on-prem admin network. Their preference is Redwood-managed orchestration with no key material leaving the HSM.

 rahul (solutions): Option A (recommended): Redwood runs orchestration agents in their VPC that trigger HSM operations via customer-controlled appliance over peered private links. Keys never leave the HSM. Option B: Customer runs orchestration and we integrate APIs. Recommend Option A for quicker onboarding.

 eva (legal): Contract considerations: manual ceremony + customer custody increases supervision clauses. We need a clause stating Redwood has no access to KEK material and only acts on signed orchestration requests. Attestation language: PS will provide signed rotation artifacts; do we require notarized attestation? They didn't ask yet.

 billing-bot: POC quote generator: base POC fee $9,500 (3-week) + PS for ceremony/runbook 3 days ($6k) + log archival (12mo) $1,200 + optional extended retention. Estimated total ~$17k. Add-on: notarized attestation + compliance review ~$2k.

 cate (security): Also need to confirm whether they require HSM tamper-evidence photos or vendor-signed hardware attestation (Thales provides that). Ask customer to confirm exact Luna model and whether they want HSM-to-HSM key replication across regions.

 rahul (solutions): Draft POC checklist (short bullets): - coordinate offline key ceremony schedule + participant list - install orchestration agent in customer VPC + peering - run key import and bind to endpoints - perform scheduled rotation + emergency rotation (2 events) - export rotation logs, generate attestation doc - failover test to DR region - deliver runbook + ops handover

 lina (sales): I'll compile questions for the SIG (HSM model, custody roles, notarization, preferred orchestration option) and send to NorthStar today. Tentative kickoff next Mon. Thanks all :raised_hands:
